balls.text: slower one, but this time it is not short enough, Hodge tries to cut it away, inside edge and that results in a single.
slower but it is so short that the leg umpire calls it a wide. Looked like it was going above the batsman's head.
pitched up to the bat and that is swung away by Hodge and deposited into the crowd behind the long-on fielder!
yep, it had to come, slower one, kept really low and that has beaten both, the batsman and the wicket-keeper. Concedes a bye.
on the middle stump and Botha has lofted him away between long-on and deep square-leg for a four. Not too many slower ones this over. So far.
pitched right up to the batsman and drilled to the long-on for a single.
wide, short and Botha slashes it to long-off for a single.
goes on to the back-foot and flicks it away to the wide long-on region for a couple of runs.
Ooooo! Leading edge and scooped over the bowler! Finally a single.
this time it is a conventional sweep and he misses it yet again! Four dots!
again, reverse sweep and it is hit so hard that it is on to the short third-man fielder in a flash! No chance of a single!
reverse sweep attempted off the first ball but missed! Did it hit the bat?

gone, stumped! Shah gave it away very early by going down the pitch and the "off-spinner" bowled a leggie. Shah was far down the track and he misses completely to allow Bisla to complete a simple job.
pitched up and as expected, slower one from Balaji. End of an excellent over from Balaji,
pitched up to the bat, on the middle, quicker and whipped away for a single
down the leg-side, a quicker one this time and it is his second wide of the over. Quicker ones have gone down...
another slower one from Balaji and Owais wanted to swing it away, again misses it and by miles!
super slow, kept low, Shah played a shot at it, could have played three more shots at it and still miss it.
quicker this time, defended on the back-foot and a single to long-on.
slower one, turning into the batsman, bounce and spin! And it is Balaji we are talking of!
short of length, down the leg-side and left alone by the batsman.
pitched on middle and Hodge gets off the mark with a nudge to the leg-side.
outside the off-stump, turning away and bounce, beats Hodge
gone, caught! Outside the off-stump, goes for a sweep and the ball does not hit the meat, caught by the short mid-wicket fielder.
and now he rotates the strike back by driving it to the off-side for a single
Goes down the track and that is timed so well that the long-off needed to not move too much but he still managed to get it for four!
angling into the middle-stump and Shah plays it out to the mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
shuffles in the crease, away from the leg-stump, then comes back to his original position before nudging it away for a single to the leg-side. That is Owais for you.
bit quicker and shorter but down the leg-side and Shah lets it go for a wide.
on the leg-side and swept away! It was slow as you would expect from Bhatia and it has been swept for a four!
pitched up to the bat and driven to long-on for a single
repeats the stroke again but this time it is squarer than before and does not get the timing on it. Come back for a couple.
Shot! First six of the innings, pitched up to the bat and it was slightly slower as well, the left-hander swipes across over mid-wicket for a six!
pitched right up to the bat and drilled through the covers for a single.
pitched up and Shah drives him to the point region for a single.
driven to the off-side for a single.
cut away to the off-side
goes down the track and drives to long-on for a single
on the middle-stump and he tries to cut it away, gets it very close on the off side but they run quickly for a single.
short ball, turning away from the bat and Shah goes to the off-stump and played away to the leg-side for a single.
pitched right up to the bat, Shah who had moved away from the stumps, drills it to long-off and runs away for a single.
slower one yet again off that long run and Shah has punched it away to the cover fielder.
short ball, slower and puled away to long-on for a single.
pitched right up to the bat and driven to long-off.
shorter ball and Owais went for a cut shot, it goes on the bounce to the cover fielder.
short of good length and driven to the point fielder.
shortish delivery and tries to cut it away, but goes to the fielder at point.
played on the leg-side for a single. Owais is playing all his deliveries from outside the off-stump.
defended on the middle and gets no run.
punched the shorter one to the wide long-on and they come back for a second!
tries to cheekily play it to third-man but misses!
short from Narine and it is punched down to long-on for a single.
drives back to the bowler who fields that. Scratch that, he should have fielded that easily, but allows it go through for an easy single!
pitched up and gets turn away from the bat! Grip and bounced!
this time it is slightly shorter and it is punched away to the leg-side for a single.
smacks it over the short mid-wicket fielder and it rolls away for the second four of the over.
uses the feet, goes to the pitch of the ball and takes it on the full, drives it to the long-on fielder for a single.
full-toss and he has finally got it into the gap between long-on and deep square-leg. Poor bowling here.
pitched outside the off-stump and Shah bends forward, and suddenly allows it to go through to the keeper!
uses his feet, down the track and scoops it over the in-field. But there is a mid-wicket and there is only a single.
full-toss on his pads and Shah only nudges it away to the deep square-leg fielder for a run.
driven to the leg-side for a single
tries to paddle sweep it but the fielder at short fine fields it.
shortish and turning away from the bat, played away to the leg-side.
pitched on the leg-stump and this time it is a lot fuller and Shah drives him through the leg-side for a single. The pitch reminds me of the 1996 World Cup semi-finals.
driven to the short mid-wicket fielder.
turns from around the wicket and bounces and hits the pads.
flicked away to the leg-side but no run to short  fine,
pitched on the leg-stump and turns further away and it beats the wicket-keeper through to the fence. Well left by Owais!
defended on the front-foot but it comes off the pad and loops up for the wicket-keeper to hold and appeal.
short ball and cut away to the sweeper fielder for a single.
pushed to the off-side this time and they are off for a run.
similar delivery and played away to the leg-side.
pitched outside the leg-stump and spinning further away for it hit the pads.
nudged away to the leg-side for a single.

pitched up again, tossed up with a bit of flight and Dravid has driven it straight to the fielder at short cover! Simple catch to the right of Tiwary and all of a sudden, the side has lost three wickets!
on the middle stump, right up to the bat, defended on the front-foot and run away.
Played away to the leg-side but the short fine-leg is present and there is no run.

short of a length and that is played away to the leg-side, wanted a single, but it had gone very close to the bowler on his left. Pathan ran towards the bowler, picked it up and threw down the stumps at the non-striker's end direct...way out of the crease.
pitched on middle and that turns away from the left-hander again! If Pathan's going to get so much turn...
defended on the front-foot to the point fielder and again wanted a single.
pitched up to the bat and Menaria defends on the off-side, wanted a single but the run wasn't on.
driven down to long-on for a single.
nudged away to the leg-side for a single to Dravid.
pulls up his length and Dravid tries to defend again, turns viciously away!
on the middle-stump and Dravid defends on the front foot to smother the spin.
on the middle-stump and spinning towards the leg-stump, played away for a single to leg-side.
pitched up again and this time it goes straight through, tried to drive but does not get any bat on it.
pitched right up to the bat and spinning away, Rahane went for a drive but seems to have got an edge through to the wicket-keeper! One down!

driven into the covers and ten Doeschate dives really well to stop it from going to the fence. What's more he also throws it at the striker's end and misses, but does enough to dirty Rahane's jersey as he dives for his crease!
on the up and Dravid has smoked it gracefully to the right of the bowler and the left of the mid-on for a four!
late cuts it away to the third-man for a single.
pulls his length back and Dravid plays it on to his pads and runs away for a single.
goes down the pitch, did not get to the pitch but still went through the shot and it beats the mid-off fielder easily!
on the middle-stump and again, not pitched up to Dravid, who punches it hard into the covers.
defends on the back-foot for the bowler to pick it up.
short ball and he sweeps it, it was going down the leg-side. The field was up and it goes for a second four
pitched right up to the bat and he drives it through the extra-cover for a four! Beauty!
on the middle-stump and Dravid whips it away for a run.
yet again, short ball from Narine but turning away and keeping a tad low, cut attempted but beaten.
very short, spinning away and the batsman flicks it away to the deep square-leg fence.
nibbled away to the third-man fielder for a single.
driven on the up but straight to the fielder at point.
short ball from Kallis and Dravid attempts a pull. It was bit of a top-edge and it goes to the fine-leg fielder...who wasn't at fine-leg!
goes for an expansive drive but misses! It was a tad wide and give Dravid some room but he failed to get any bat on it.
short ball, Rahane defends on his back-foot and rushes off for a single.
short and Rahane wanted to pull it away. Did not come on to the bat too well and it goes to square-leg.
pitched on the middle and up to the bat, he drives to mid-on but too firmly for any runs.
defended on the back-foot and Dravid was off! There was no run there as the bowler came quickly to pick up and throw it back. Dravid was well in.
shimmies a little down the track and Balaji changed his line towards the leg-side. Dravid flicked it away and it goes over the in-field.
short of a good length yet again and Rahane defends with soft hands. Dravid was awake to the possibility of a single and they cross over.
on the off-stump, not pitched up too much and pushed into the covers.
on to his pads and it was full, Rahane should have probably got it away over the in-field for a four. Goes only to square-leg.
bounces high on the batsman and Rahane rolls his wrist over that cut to the third-man fielder for a single.
on the middle stump and this time Dravid whips to square-leg for a single.
on the off-stump and short of a good length, driven to the cover region.
taps it to the off-side and a misfield at point allows the batsman to go through for a single.
short of the good length and Rahane has punched it through the extra-cover region for a four! Slow pitch or not, the outfield is rather quick.
on the middle with a bit more bounce than what Balaji got, Rahane defends it to the leg-side.
outside the off-stump, swinging away from the bat and he has let it go to the wicket-keeper. A watchful start from the former Indian Test number three.
pitched on the middle and up to the batsman yet again, Dravid pulls out his front foot and drives it back to the bowler.
pitched outside the off-stump and right up to the bat, Dravid wanted to drive it through the covers but the ball did not come on to him.
pitched on the middle this time, adjusting his line and it swings just that little bit away from the batsman. Defended on the front foot.
a similar delivery from Balaji but this time Dravid does not allow it to go through, he was on the front foot and still cut away through the point region for the first four of the night.
pitched outside the off-stump, going away from the batsman and Dravid leaves it alone like he loves doing in the longer format.
pitched on the leg-stump and Tendo has smacked it over the leg-side for a six! That is an excellent shot to end the game, Kolkata have made it two wins in two games here!
pitches on the leg-stump and turns away from the batsman and beats the outside-edge of the bat.
delicate and cheeky! Pathan has late cut that one to the third-man fence for four, the fielder was up in the circle and there was no chance he could get to this one. Scores level.
on the middle-stump and the batsman slogs it away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single.
or has he! Slower one and he goes down the track and tries to hit him over the field on the off-side, but gets a leading edge and it is caught at point.
slogged away over mid-wicket and that is gone over the fence for a six! Slower, on the length and he has almost got his team home!
tries to hoick it over the short fine-leg and the bowler went for a huge appeal. It did hit his pads but the ball was pitching outside the leg-stump and given not-out.
outside the off-stump and tapped it to the off-side for a single.
defends to the right of the bowler and they run across for a single.
short and down the leg-side for the umpire to stretch his arms wide.
slogs it away but it was a slower one and that goes straight to the long-on fielder for a single.

fullish and drilled to the covers, where Dravid fields and throws it back to the keeper. Shakib was down the pitch but he comes back really quickly and the third-umpire, who was called to adjudicate this, gives it not-out.
shortish and Pathan gets off the mark with a pull to deep square-leg.
heaved away to the leg-side and this one goes on a bounce to the deep square-leg fielder for a single.
sweeps Trivedi and it beats both, the short fine-leg and the deep square-leg fielder for a boundary. Second successive over where a boundary is scored off the first ball.
wrong 'un, attempts a late cut but it goes straight to the fielder at short third-man. Excellent end to the over.
pitched up, turning into the bat and Pathan defends it back to the bowler.
wrong 'un, spins away and defended on the off-side.

goes down the pitch and Hogg not only slows it down but also gets it to go away from the bat, beaten all ends, and the wicket-keeper has whipped off the bails. Not too dissimilar from the Owais Shah stumping.
again a reverse sweep and this goes to the right of the short third-man fielder for a couple.
tries to go for a reverse sweep and it is mis-hit, and then it is misfielded too at the short third-man by Amit Singh, who dives over it!
pushed it away to the leg-side for a single and we will have a Time-Out now.
tries to cut away the shorter one from Trivedi but this one goes straight to the fielder inside the circle at covers.
slower and shorter and Shakib pulls it away to the deep square-leg boundary for a couple of runs. Good fielding by Menaria restricts it to two.
goes down the track and driven to long-on. Wanted a second run but decide against it.
slower one, tries to cut it though the in-field on the off-side but gets only a single.
slower, shorter and it is hit away to the leg-side for a single.
shorter one, darted into the bat and pulled away for a single. Excellent over given the circumstances.
gone, caught! What a wicket! Four balls for next to nothing and Bisla went inside out to the extra-cover boundary, there was a fielder there, and he judges it to perfection.
quicker one, tries to cut away to the point fielder. Straight to him.
pitched up and the batsman went for a big one over long-on but it is mistimed. Falls short of the fielder, Botha.
slower from Menaria and slants it into the batsman.
short outside the off-stump and cut away to the sweeper fielder.
driven down to the fine-leg for a single.
this was slower and flighted, cut away and should have gone straight on the bounce to the fielder, Hogg, but he misfields! Almost goes to the fence.
comes down the track, shorter again and turning away.
this time it is shorter, cut away and this should be four...but tell you what Rahane dives really well at the sweeper boundary and saves a run!
gets to the pitch of the ball this time and has spanked it over the long-on fence for a six! Finally a boundary after almost four overs...
goes down the track and plays a controlled shot to long-off. Was not up to the pitch of the ball.
goes down the pitch and driven to long-off for a single.
goes down the track, chips it inside-out to the deep extra-cover region. They come back well for the third run.
tries to play it to the leg-side but no run yet again.
slower, flighted, and Tiwary goes for a cut. Bisla wanted to come through for a single but sent back.
driven to long-on for a single
big, big shout again and the umpire shakes his head! Quicker one and reverse sweep attempted but the umpire has nothing of it. Was hitting outside the off-stump, good decision.
swept again and a single for Bisla, he has swept really well this innings.
flighted well, Tiwary hits it on the full for a single to long-on.
another wrong 'un and shorter this time, goes on the back-foot but played back to the bowler.
wrong 'un to the new man, did not pick it and beats the outside edge.
pitched up to the bat and swept away by Bisla to deep square-leg.
bowled straight on the middle but spinning away for a wide.
huge shout for an lbw and Hogg held that pose with his hands stretched for almost 20 seconds. Not out given.
pitched up on the off-stump, flighted and played away to the leg-side.

gone, lbw! He was attempting a lot of sweeps and he tries it again but misses. Huge appeal and the umpire gives it out...was turning into the bat, but hit in line with the stumps and should have hit the stumps.
goes down the track and does not get to the pitch. Hits the pad.
full-toss on the middle and Kallis manages to get bat on this one, sweeps away and comes back for the second
goes outside the off-stump and attempts a sweep. A bit of an appeal.
turning into the batsman and Kallis looks to defend, pops up from his pads.
pitched right up to the bat and Kallis sweeps him away to the fine-leg fielder for a single.
played back to the bowler for no run.
pitched right up to the batsman and that is swept away to the deep square-leg for a single.
too short but spinning in and that is played away to the leg-side for a single.
wrong 'un and sweep attempted, missed and well-kept by the keeper.
played away through point and that goes to the fence. It was a bit short and he punched it but did that real late.
goes down the track to the shorter one and plays it away to the off-side for a single. There was a bit of a stutter but a misfield allows him to run away for a single.
goes on to the back-foot and punched it down to long-on.
defended on the back-foot to the leg-side and it is a single.
drives it to long-on after shimming down the pitch.
short ball and the batsman has pulled it away to the fence. It was a slower bouncer and Bisla picked it up really well!
punched down the ground for a single to long-off

turn and bounce and the batsman attempts a reverse sweep. Beats the bat, beats the stumps, beats the wicket-keeper, beats the fielder at short fine-leg and goes for a four. It also beats Kallis that the umpire hasn't called it wides, but Asad Rauf says that a reverse-sweep was attempted.
turns in to the batsman and there is nothing the batsman can do about it.
outside the leg-stump and Bisla sweeps it away. The fielder misfielded at fine-leg, allowing the batsman to come back to the second, appeal for a run-out but he was well in.
this time he pitches it up to the batsman and Kallis sweeps it to the fine-leg for a single.
on the middle and it rips into the batsman. Kallis is hit on his thigh pad.
pitched outside the off-stump and gets some turn. Tapped away to the off-side.
angling into the batsman and the non-striker quickly calls the batsman for a single. Nine off the over.
turning away from the batsman and Bisla dabs it to the covers for a run.
short of length and played it away to the sweeper region for a single.
on the middle and Kallis drives it back to the bowler.
changes the length, bowls it fuller and down the leg-side and sweep attempted and missed. But it is a wide called.
goes down the pitch and smashes it over the extra-cover region!
Bisla tries to sweep it away but misses hitting the middle of the bat.

Oooh, close! Almost another run-out, Kallis dabbed it to the off-side and he took a couple of steps before his loud call of 'No'. The fielder threw it at the non-striker's end, and Bisla was out of the crease when the ball passed he stumps, would have been out.
outside the off-stump but Bisla walks into the shot and plays it away to the leg-side for a run.
slower one, Bisla waited and smacked it through the covers for a four!
short of a length and Bisla wanted to swing it away, but missed the ball.
on the middle stump and it is played away to the leg-side for a run.
driven straight and it beats the fielder at mid-off. Pitched right up and Kallis needed no second invites.
pitches almost outside the leg-stump and turn takes it outside the off. Yep, a lot of turn there alright.
on to the back-foot and forced away to the long-off region.
straighter one and Kallis defends it back to the bowler.
sweeps him to short fine-leg for a single
makes him change the length and the line with that previous shot, it is wide down the leg-side.
gives himself room, first ball and it was short and turned away from the bat. Beaten!
on the middle stump, turning away, played through the covers for a single.

confusion, run-out! This is a big wicket, Gambhir is run-out after a yes-no situation with Kallis and he is yards short of the crease. Kallis played it to the leg-side and wanted a run, Gambhir didn't, then in a span of a moment, the roles were reversed and in the end, Gambhir was run-out at the striker's end. The bowler threw the stumps down direct!
goes down the pitch yet again and the bowler shortens the length further. Pulled it away to the deep square-leg where Menaria fields well.
slower one, on the pads, and Gambhir plays it away, leading edge to the off-side and the fielder has thrown the stumps down. Third umpire called for and Gambhir is just in.
defended softly on the off-side and runs away for a single.
down the track, suddenly stops and plays it away to the leg-side. Single for GG.
pitched fuller and turning away, Gambhir plays it away to the off-side.
on the middle-stump and driven to the leg-side for a single.
short of length, quicker and Kallis defends well.
goes down the pitch and attempts to drive it, but he shortens the length. Plays it away to the leg-side.
pitched up to the bat this time and Kallis drives to the leg-side.
swept away by Kallis this time, goes for four between short fine-leg and square-leg in the circle! Tossed up and slower.
tries to play it to the leg-side and he gets a leading edge to the short third-man fielder.
on the middle stump, good length, slower and Gambhir wanted to tap and run. He tapped alright, but did not run.
again down the leg-side and this time it is to the right-hander. Kallis nurdles it away to the leg-side for a single
that was outside the leg-stump and Gambhir plays it away to the short fine-leg for a single.
again short of length and edged away to the third-man fielder.
outside the off-stump, short of length, played away to the off-side.
short outside the off-stump and Gambhir has cut it well, in fact it was the placement to the right of the fielder to get a four!
ball on middle and he leaves it alone! Gambhir thought it was going down with the leg-side but it did not...
this time he does succeed in going down the track and he hits him inside-out towards the extra-cover region.
wanted to go down the pitch but it was a tad shorter and he plays it back to the bowler.
down the leg-side and a huge appeal, but the umpire gives it a wide! Seems to have brushed something on the way.
turns into the batsman yet again and that it nudged away to the deep square-leg region for a single. Gambhir on strike now.
turn and a lot of it into the batsman! Nudged away to the leg-side.
